name: dsh-audio
description: Audio: WAV/AIFF/FLAC as a waveform (one row per channel, adaptive ruler, RMS core, sample-level zoom, selection, audio-clock playback) plus the MEDIA panel in the left column - a bounded scan of every audio, image, video and GIF file the conversation can reach, with an inline preview and a one-click hand-off to the tab that owns the type, and, under Devices, this machine's audio console. Client-only, read in 2 MiB windows.
